So once he’s already decided, every word you say just becomes evidence. There’s no version of “fine” that doesn’t prove his point, and no version of the truth that doesn’t hand him the job of managing you. Leaving the porch is the only move that isn’t a losing one.

That’s not you being difficult. That’s a room with no exit except the door.

What would he have had to do differently in that second — look worried without looking decided?
